 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * h):
        # Reflect at each boundary, duplicating the edge row.
        block, pos = divmod(r, h)
        src = (h - 1 - pos) if block % 2 == 0 else pos
        row = grid[src]
        out.append(list(reversed(row)) + list(row))
    return out
